|rulings=* Lost function - Only targets active cards. Not inactive cards (e.g. cards on a captive/missing character) or supporting cards (e.g. cards on [[Crash Site Memorial]]).

* Lost function - Will not 'steal back' a weapon that Dark has stolen from Light.
